verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Anytype exposes a local API/MCP server so external AI assistants (Claude, Cursor, Gemini CLI, etc.) can connect to and manipulate Anytype data, but this is the reverse of a built-in assistant embedded in the product's own UI/workflow — Anytype is the data source being acted upon, not the host of an assistant. No evidence describes an in-app chat/assistant feature that users can delegate tasks to natively.
